emails.subject: Price parity on Clumping Bentonite Unscented 10 kg
emails.body:
Hi Sanjay,

On MarketB, Clumping Bentonite Unscented 10 kg is listed at ₹566 on your own storefront, 12.0% under our price, for 9 days. That breaks price parity and sits under the ₹624 minimum advertised price. Please restore parity by Friday; we will not follow the lower price down.

Thanks

emails.subject: Price protection request: Chicken & Rice Adult 3 kg
emails.body:
Hi Anil,

A competitor on MarketA has been 6.9% under our price on Chicken & Rice Adult 3 kg for 9 days. Matching would take our margin to 15.5%, under the 20.0% floor. Could you share price protection of ₹41 a unit for the next period?

Thanks
